definitions.explanation: A formal term for the autumn season, used especially in compound words and official contexts such as event names and academic schedules.

examples.japanese: {秋季|しゅうき}⟦{入学|にゅうがく}→入学：02092_nyuugaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{制度|せいど}→制度：03291_seido⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There is an autumn enrollment system.

examples.japanese: {秋季|しゅうき}⟦{大会|たいかい}→大会：03386_taikai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日程|にってい}→日程：04289_nittei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{決|き}まった→決まる：01233_kimaru⟧。
examples.english: The schedule for the autumn tournament has been decided.

examples.japanese: {秋季|しゅうき}⟦{限定|げんてい}→限定：10997_gentei⟧⟦メニュー→メニュー：11166_menyuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{集|あつ}めている→集める：01170_atsumeru⟧。
examples.english: The autumn-only menu is gaining popularity.

notes:
USAGE:
A formal, written-style word for autumn. In everyday conversation, ⟦{秋|あき}→秋：02276_aki⟧ is used instead. {秋季|しゅうき} appears in official event names, academic schedules, and sports contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {秋季|しゅうき}⟦{大会|たいかい}→大会：03386_taikai⟧ (autumn tournament)
- {秋季|しゅうき}⟦{入学|にゅうがく}→入学：02092_nyuugaku⟧ (autumn enrollment)
- {秋季|しゅうき}⟦{限定|げんてい}→限定：10997_gentei⟧ (autumn-only)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{秋|あき}→秋：02276_aki⟧: everyday word for autumn
- ⟦{春季|しゅんき}→春季：16605_shunki⟧: spring season (formal equivalent for spring)
